specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Fast Charging, High Power Output, Data Sync

features: 100W SUPERVOOC Fast Charging: Supports up to 100W high-speed charging with 10A output for fast and efficient power delivery. Designed for SUPERVOOC compatible smartphones, tablets and Type-C devices
10A High Power Output: Built to handle high current safely for stable charging performance. Compatible with OnePlus, Oppo, Realme and other USB Type-C devices
480Mbps Data Transfer: Enjoy fast and reliable data syncing with transfer speeds up to 480Mbps. Easily transfer photos, videos, music and files between devices
Durable Cable Design: Premium exterior improves durability and protects the cable from bending, twisting and daily wear for long-lasting performance
Wide Compatibility: Compatible with OnePlus, Oppo, Realme smartphones, tablets, power banks, chargers and other USB Type-C supported devices
USB A to Type C Connection: Features USB A connector on one end and Type C connector on the other for versatile charging and data transfer across multiple devices
